This is example parsing code. The text file `2025-05-10-test.txt` contains a list of messages downloaded from <https://aprs.fi>. APRS packets don't have time stamps, those were added by <https://aprs.fi>.

```python
from aprspy import APRS
msg = 'KF8EEZ-11>APLIGA,WIDE1-1,WIDE2-1,qAR,KB9QDI:/165213h3943.08N/08409.86WO000/000/A=000915 002TxC  22.00C  974.03hPa  5.54V 05S LightAPRS-W 2.0 !w-(!'
p = APRS.parse_packet(msg)
```


